name: myGit
author: Bedusec Labs
description: myGit is a lightweight, high-performance GitHub client for Android. Built for developers who need to stay connected to their repositories without the bloat.

name: Xploit Hunter
author: Xploit Hunter
description: Xploit Hunter is a portable security assessment toolkit for authorized penetration testers and security researchers. It includes web vulnerability scanning, a manual request builder, and a payload library for SQLi, XSS, and common web flaws. Use only on systems you own or have explicit permission to test. Unauthorized access is illegal and strictly prohibited. Requires Android 7.0+.

name: iBrowser
author: Icii White
description: iBrowser is built for speed and simplicity. It loads pages fast, uses minimal data, and keeps your browsing smooth. With a clean interface and essential privacy controls, it’s made for users who just want a reliable, no‑frills web experience. Perfect for daily browsing without the clutter.

name: AIDE
author: Google Play
description: AIDE is a lightweight integrated development environment that lets you code, compile, and run Android apps directly on your Android device. Built by Appfour, it supports Java, C++, and XML with features like code completion, real-time error checking, and Git integration. Ideal for learning Android development or making quick edits on the go. Fully compatible with Eclipse and Android Studio projects. No root required.

name: WhatsApp
author: Meta
description: WhatsApp is a messaging and calling app that lets you stay connected with friends and family around the world. Send text messages, share photos and videos, make voice and video calls, all protected with end-to-end encryption. It works over Wi-Fi or mobile data and supports group chats with up to 1,024 participants. Simple, reliable, and used by billions globally. Available for Android, iOS, and desktop.
